subject: english
question:
Choose the most appropriate synonym of the underlined word.

Only a rounded bar and three rotting bathtubs remain in the **__decrepit__** club.
solution:
The correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word "**decrepit**" means** something that is old and in poor condition.**
 
• The most appropriate synonym for "**decrepit**" in this context is "**wrecked**".
 
• Other options like "**robust**", "**luxurious**", and "**hearty**" do not fit the meaning of the word "**decrepit**".

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 4**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Robust** means strong and healthy.
 
• **Luxurious** means extremely comfortable or elegant.
 
• **Hearty** means enthusiastic or hearty in nature.
